name: forecast.account_demands_intraday
purpose: Query one account and date window with ordered ownership resolution and unchanged native records.

list.description: Read native account records; resolve omitted ownership from Duckdog, cache, then live directory.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: One explicit account alias; ANY and batches are refused.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Explicit entity constraint; resolved from account directory when omitted.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.description: Explicit bank constraint; resolved from account directory when omitted.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Inclusive native value date YYYYMMDD; intraday requires the same day.

result_identity.description: Native selected account alias returned by baseline detail.

history.time_basis: selected query day (startDate/endDate); statisticalDate is an HH:mm slot

identity_description: Native identity within the exact saved account/date scope.
limitations: Account alias and ordered YYYYMMDD date bounds are required. No ANY acquisition or fanout.
Explicit entity and bank together skip directory acquisition; partial constraints are never overwritten.
Missing ownership resolves in source order Duckdog, saved cash.accounts, live directory. Multiple matches select the first source row with provenance warning.
Directory is a current ownership reference and does not establish historical ownership. Configured source corruption or selected simulated ownership is a hard failure without live fallback.
All native record fields, nested values and response order are retained; no legacy runtime imports.
Intraday uses one day, preserves native amount strings and labels without assigning currency/timezone; empty is valid, nonempty completeness requires all 96 slots.
Bare offline reads replay the saved query; different account/date/ownership scopes have unproved coverage.

Live ownership unions internal cash and baseline catalogs with independent source coverage and nonblank ownership conflict guards. Baseline-present keys own the value, including null; selected baseline detail only fills absent required ownership keys. No directory-wide detail sweep.

Live ownership directory quality retains ACCOUNT_SOURCE_MISMATCH when cash and baseline identity inventories differ. A resolved alias can still return in default live mode, but strict queries and refresh reject incomplete directory coverage.
